title: Unused media
description: Metadata for files the server considers unlinked to campaigns.
caution: The list is generated by a server-side relationship check. A file appearing here does not mean it is safe to delete
refreshing: Refreshing the list. Previously loaded records are shown for now.
limits: The server may limit the response. Completeness is unconfirmed; server pagination is not connected.
search: Search loaded file names and paths
localHint: Search and sorting apply only to loaded records and do not request other files from the server.

empty.title: The check returned no files
empty.body: There are no records in this response. This does not confirm that the server has no other unused files.

noMatches.title: No matches found
noMatches.body: Change or clear your search of the loaded records.

missing.title: Server function unavailable
missing.body: The unused media function was not found or is not exposed in the API. Contact the backend developer.

denied.title: Access to this list denied
denied.body: The server did not allow reading this metadata. Check your account permissions or sign in again.

unavailable.title: Could not load the list
unavailable.body: Check your connection and try again. Contact your administrator if the error persists.

invalidResponse.title: Could not read the server response
invalidResponse.body: The response does not match the expected metadata list format. Contact the backend developer.
